incident.cause: Review Queue publication was unnecessarily conditional on every unrelated safe execution batch completing successfully.

implementation.design: Seal the fresh review classification and full database baseline before execution, then independently reconcile the review rows against current production state.
guard_changes: The sealed contract accepts only a complete safe/review partition with zero blocked rows.
Every executable row must be VERIFY_NO_CHANGE for pre-execution publication.
The source and database baseline are SHA-256 bound and copied to immutable artifact filenames before apply.
Current offer, mapping, canonical identity, price, stock and URLs are checked again before queue publication.
review-only dispatch skips catalogue apply, control-plan registration, postflight and idempotency.

regression.name: 10 Reps review evidence survives a later partial execution failure

production.next_gate: Merge after green CI, dispatch one 10 Reps review-only operation, then verify exactly 16 active queue cards and zero catalogue/control writes.
